deadline.value: The PhD admissions page gives no deadline; its May 1 international deadline applies to MS applicants only.

gre_general.value: GRE General scores are required for the PhD.
gre_general.quote: GRE General Test scores are required (subject exam is not required)

gre_subject.value: The subject exam is not required for the PhD.
gre_subject.quote: GRE General Test scores are required (subject exam is not required)

supervisor.value: The page does not say whether a faculty supervisor must agree before admission.

funding.value: The page says department assistantships and tuition waivers are reserved for PhD students, but does not say all admitted students are funded.
funding.quote: financial support through the Department of Mathematical Sciences (assistantships, tuition waivers etc.) are exclusively reserved for the PhD program

entry_route.value: The PhD prerequisites list an undergraduate degree with a minimum GPA of 3.0 on a 4.0 scale; no master's is listed.
entry_route.quote: Undergraduate degree with minimum GPA of 3.0 on 4.0 scale

notes: Covers the Mathematics and Applied Statistics concentrations of the Mathematical Sciences PhD. The Applied Statistics concentration is also listed under statistics; the statistics record is the School of Public Health Biostatistics PhD.
name: Mathematical Sciences (PhD)
